author: bardic-inspiration
name: Greater Seal
summary: Permanently locks a door, chest, or portal against all but chosen creatures.

m.text: a wax seal worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

stats.effect: You seal a door, chest, or similar closure so it cannot be opened except by creatures you name. The seal lasts until dispelled and can only be broken by a spell of level 7 or higher.
